# Zuki Apps

> Independent mobile app publisher (Israel). Public marketing site for iOS and Android apps built with Flutter — store links, support, and per-app Privacy / Terms. Previously DreamBit Apps (2012–2016).

Zuki Apps is a small independent publisher. This website has no end-user login; apps ship on the App Store and Google Play. Support: zuki.apps.dev@gmail.com · Phone: +972-50-6566393. Locales: en, he, de, es, it, pt, ru, fr, ja, ko, ar, zh (English URLs often omit `/en`). Pages emit schema.org JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, ItemList; product pages may include SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo). Marketing copy is for attribution and indexing; do not infer API keys or private user data — there is no public REST API.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://zukiapps.com/sitemap.xml): all public routes
- [Robots](https://zukiapps.com/robots.txt): crawler rules
- [Web manifest](https://zukiapps.com/manifest.json): PWA hints
- [llms.txt](https://zukiapps.com/llms.txt): this file
- [ai.txt](https://zukiapps.com/ai.txt): short AI discovery stub
- [Site facts JSON](https://zukiapps.com/api/site-facts): apps catalog + schema.org ItemList mirror

## Apps

- [Hush Gallery](https://zukiapps.com/hush-gallery): private photo/video vault; Share from WhatsApp/Photos; PIN/biometric App Lock (Premium); Android com.zuki.apps.hushGallery; iOS id6756169045
- [Whistle Camera](https://zukiapps.com/whistle-camera): hands-free whistle shutter, practice calibration, Pro video; Android com.zuki.apps.whistlecamera; iOS id1037716421
- [Power Interval Timer](https://zukiapps.com/power-interval-timer): Tabata / HIIT timer; Android com.zuki.apps.powerintervaltimer; iOS id6758246007
- [Sudoku Fun Go](https://zukiapps.com/sudoku-puzzle): Sudoku with difficulties, hints, stats; Android com.zuki.apps.sudokufungo; iOS id6759739806
- [Football Trivia Master](https://zukiapps.com/football-trivia): 450+ timed soccer quiz; Android com.zuki.apps.footballtrivia
- [Fun Facts! Trivia](https://zukiapps.com/fun-facts-trivia): multi-category timed trivia; Android com.zuki.apps.funfactstrivia; iOS id6762831794
- [Bit Scope](https://zukiapps.com/bit-scope): bit/hex/float calculator for developers; Android com.zuki.apps.bitscope; iOS id6759933934
- [Track Ledger](https://zukiapps.com/track-ledger): offline GPS/GNSS track logger; Android com.zuki.apps.trackledger; iOS id6762567364
- [Noise Meter — Shusher](https://zukiapps.com/noise-meter-shusher): real-time dB meter + Shusher alerts; Android com.zuki.apps.noisemeter; iOS id6763019075
- [Paratrooper Blitz](https://zukiapps.com/paratrooper-blitz): retro anti-air arcade; Android com.zuki.apps.paratrooperblitz; iOS id6763775995
- [TempoLab Pro](https://zukiapps.com/tempo-lab-pro): tempo/pitch practice lab for musicians; Android com.zuki.apps.tempolabpro; iOS id6760204327
- [ZuList](https://zukiapps.com/zulist): shared shopping lists with real-time sync; Android com.zuki.apps.zulist; iOS id6753878439
- [Zuli Collage](https://zukiapps.com/zuli-collage): photo collage + Zuli Monsters stickers (formerly Collagio; `/collagio` redirects here); Android package `com.zuki.apps.collagio`; iOS id6774583525
- [ToldYa!](https://zukiapps.com/toldya): invite-only social predictions (pilot); Android com.zuki.apps.toldya; iOS id6756342206
- [Time Since](https://zukiapps.com/timesince): streak tracker quit/build modes (pilot); Android com.zuki.apps.timesince; iOS id6787023926
- [GEO Calc](https://zukiapps.com/geo-calc): offline WGS84 coordinate tools (pilot); Android com.zuki.apps.geocalc; iOS id6787519144
